title: malva purdiaei
intro: Malva purdiaei, commonly known as marshmallow plant, is a perennial herb native to Mexico and Central America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and providing relief from respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Malva purdiaei include its demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to protect and heal mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Malva purdiaei include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
